tiers.text: The largest separation you need is 10 in a box of 100. Most pairs can be skipped before any distance is computed.
Grid the box into cells of side at least 10 and compare only neighbouring cells. Or use cKDTree, but read which way its count_neighbors treats a pair exactly at the edge.

If the diff table shows a few counts moving between adjacent bins, those are pairs within rounding error of an edge. Either match the reference arithmetic (sqrt first, then compare), or declare toleranced in race.toml with a Poisson-error justification. Re-run after any change to fast.py or race.toml.
